title: Additional-System Rate for Members with a Recent Harbison Installation (Comfort Club)
content:
When a Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements member has recently signed a Harbison installation contract, each enrolled system beyond the first is billed at a share of the tier's additional-system annual rate on the dues of a reinstated term. The rule reads the signing of the member's installation contracts under Replacement System Installations.

## Additional-system share rule
- Most recently signed Harbison installation contract signed **fewer than 12 months** (the new-installation months) before the date of handling: the share is the new-installation share of **0.6**.
- Signed **at least 12 but fewer than 36 months** (the recent-installation months) before: the share is the recent-installation share of **0.8**.
- Otherwise: no reduced share under this rule.

## Per additional system (hypothetical tier additional-system annual rate 169.00)

| Most recent contract signed | Share | Billed per additional system |
|---|---|---|
| 5 months before | 0.6 | 101.40 |
| 20 months before | 0.8 | 135.20 |
| 40 months before, or never | — | not changed by this rule |

## Boundary points
- Signed exactly 12 months before: 0.8.
- Signed exactly 36 months before: outside both bands.
